user_report: That was extraordinary. You did a really great job. Hugely improved. I only noticed a handful of graphical glitches and so far nothing that affects gameplay.

reported_defects.observation: Vertical lines in title clouds in the top third of the screen.
Power-up TVs function but appear black; contents are not visible.
Small brick platforms are invisible unless Sonic stands on them.
Sometimes sprites seem to float slightly during vertical screen movement.

audio: No new audio failure reported. V0.040 remains the explicit hardware sound confirmation; this report does not separately certify each V0.044 track/event.
limits: Positive qualitative playtest, not exhaustive zone acceptance or measured console timing. Act/era/coordinates, clips, video mode and repeated cold-boot results were not supplied. Do not require those before investigating.
historical_manifests: Packaging/deployment manifests remain immutable pre-test evidence. This later report supersedes their pending-test status without rewriting them.
